recommendations.title: Refresh battery comparison with explicit SigenStor drawbacks
recommendations.details: Add a dedicated subsection on the page that explicitly lists SigenStor's disadvantages: absence of published round‑trip efficiency, limitations from the low‑voltage all‑in‑one design (less inverter flexibility), incomplete public warranty fine print/throughput caps, and the 2025 Energy Controller recall context with guidance for Swedish customers. Include recommended questions for customers to ask (serial/model checks, firmware/connector status) and link to support/contact info.

recommendations.title: Create an FAQ entry about the 2025 Sigenergy Energy Controller recall
recommendations.details: Write a short FAQ or advisory that explains the November 2025 voluntary recall (which components were affected, that the recall targeted single‑phase Energy Controllers in Australia, what remedial actions were taken, and whether Swedish three‑phase installations are impacted). Provide clear next steps for customers with existing or planned SigenStor systems (how to verify model/firmware, who to contact for checks or upgrades).

recommendations.title: Refresh technical comparison to show missing efficiency and warranty specifics
recommendations.details: Update the technical comparison table/page to add explicit fields (or notes) where manufacturers do not publish round‑trip efficiency or where warranty terms are incomplete, and call out SigenStor in those fields. Also add an ROI/pricing note suggesting customers request manufacturer data during quotation to allow accurate payback calculations.
